package.name: lekiwi_isaac_hardware
package.description: ros2_control hardware interface that bridges the LeKiwi robot controller_manager to NVIDIA Isaac Sim 5.1 through the officially supported isaacsim.ros2.bridge OmniGraph nodes (ROS2PublishJointState / ROS2SubscribeJointState -> IsaacArticulationController -> /World/LeKiwi).
